title: SpaceX Announces Ambitions for Starlink Mobile Carrier
excerpt: SpaceX plans to build a 5G network on Earth and launch Starlink Mobile to compete with major carriers like AT&T, Verizon, and T-Mobile.
body_html: SpaceX has announced plans to establish Starlink Mobile as a major mobile carrier. The company, owned by Elon Musk, has already deployed thousands of direct-to-cell satellites in orbit. Its next major challenge involves constructing a ground-based 5G network to compete directly with established providers such as AT&T, Verizon, and T-Mobile. As part of these expansion efforts, the company has secured a deal in pursuit of its new carrier ambitions.
